proposed_status_reason: Cap rate of 6.0% is significantly below the 10% threshold. Even with optimistic assumptions (high-end rent of $4,000/mo and self-management), cap rate would only reach ~10.5%, which is marginal and requires eliminating professional management entirely. Base case analysis uses conservative rent estimate ($3,200/mo) and standard 20% management fee typical for Panama City Beach STR market. Additionally, special assessments remain UNKNOWN with LOW confidence—the 1983 building has recent major permit activity suggesting potential capital needs, and an estoppel certificate is required to verify assessment status. The high HOA fee ($630/mo) substantially erodes returns.

optimistic_case.notes: High-end rent estimate with professional management

self_managed_optimistic.notes: Requires eliminating professional management and achieving high-end rent projections; not representative of hands-off investment

risk_factors: Special assessments UNKNOWN - building age (1983) and recent permit activity suggest potential capital needs
Highly seasonal rental market with weak winter occupancy (25-35%)
HOA fee ($630/mo) exceeds scrutiny threshold and is above county median
Rent projection relies on STR income which is inherently variable
